intro.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
intro.text: Three branch lines are converging. Keep every change on one tested integration route.

success.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
success.text: The merge controller has stabilized CI Valley. Production District is visible across the water.

failure.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
failure.text: An isolated branch drifted away from the shared release line.

targetMisconception: Merge at the end is fine.
rules: Each change joins the shared pipeline
Tests run before the shared artifact is released
win: All branch changes integrate through one tested path
fail: A branch bypasses the test gate

engineerMode.artifact:
name: verify-pr
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

annotation.text: Every pull request triggers the same checks before merging.
Integration is verified continuously, not delayed until release day.
